title.en: The complete correspondence of law and history

statement.zh: 一族历史恰在含有它的拼接时是某个律的历史族；历史把律固定到死路为止。
statement.en: A family of histories is a law's exactly where it holds its splices, and histories fix a law up to its dead ends.

laws.en: A history over configurations of any type and moves of any type is a pair of sequences indexed by the natural numbers; a law admits it where every step it takes is a step of the law, as each run of the law is. The law a family of histories shows has as steps those its histories take: it admits each of them, and it is contained in a law exactly where that law admits each of them.
laws.zh: 任意类型的配置与任意类型的动作上，一段历史是一对以自然数为索引的序列；律容许它，是指它走的每一步都是律的一步，律的每个运行都如此。一族历史所显示的律以其历史所走的步为步：它容许其中每段历史，并且它含于一个律，恰在该律容许其中每段历史时。

laws.en: A family of histories holds its splices where every sequence the law it shows admits is in it. The histories a law admits hold their splices, and a family is the family of histories some law admits exactly where it holds its splices, the law it shows then being one such law.
laws.zh: 一族历史含有它的拼接，是指它所显示的律容许的每个序列都在族中。律所容许的历史含有它们的拼接；一族历史恰在含有它的拼接时，是某个律所容许的历史族，此时它所显示的律就是这样一个律。

laws.en: A family of histories is consistent where no two of its histories, nor one history at two times, take one move at one configuration to two outcomes. The law it shows is determined, each move at a configuration having at most one outcome, exactly where the family is consistent; a family is the family of histories some determined law admits exactly where it holds its splices and is consistent.
laws.zh: 一族历史一致，是指其中任何两段历史、或一段历史的两个时刻，都不以同一动作把同一配置带到两处。它所显示的律确定（在一个配置处每个动作至多一个结果），恰在族一致时；一族历史恰在含有它的拼接且一致时，是某个确定的律所容许的历史族。

laws.en: The live steps of a law are those some history it admits takes. Each is a step of the law; a law and its live steps admit the same histories; two laws admit the same histories exactly where they have the same live steps; and the live steps of the live law are its own steps, so it has no dead end.
laws.zh: 律的活的步是它所容许的某段历史所走的步。每个活的步都是律的步；律与它的活的步容许同样的历史；两个律恰在活的步相同时容许同样的历史；活的律的活的步就是它自己的步，所以它没有死路。

laws.en: Sending each law to the family of histories it admits matches laws, taken up to their live steps, one to one with the families holding their splices: each image holds its splices, each such family is an image, and two laws have the same image, compared at every history, exactly where their live steps agree.
laws.zh: 把每个律送到它所容许的历史族，使按活的步计的律与含有拼接的历史族一一对应：每个像都含有拼接，每个这样的族都是某个像，两个律恰在活的步相同时有同一个像（逐段历史比较）。

laws.en: With histories that stop, a law is fixed by them: two laws have the same finite courses, each from a configuration by a list of moves to a configuration, exactly where they have the same steps, so no dead end remains.
laws.zh: 以会停止的历史，律由它们固定：两个律恰在步相同时有同样的有限历程（每段自一个配置经一列动作到一个配置），所以没有死路留下。

laws.en: A family of finite courses, each from a configuration by a list of moves to a configuration, is made of its steps where the empty course goes from each configuration to it alone and a course is a first step followed by the rest; it is the family of some law's finite courses exactly where it is made of its steps, the law being its one-step part.
laws.zh: 一族有限历程（每段自一个配置经一列动作到一个配置）由其步组成，是指空历程从每个配置只到它自己，且一段历程是第一步接其余；它恰在由其步组成时，是某个律的有限历程族，该律即其一步的部分。

hypotheses.en: Every law on configurations and moves of any types, and every family of histories: the laws take no hypothesis on either.
hypotheses.zh: 任意类型的配置与动作上的每个律与每族历史：这些规律对二者不加假设。
历史有两种：不终止的序列（核心的运行）与有限的动作序列（Trace）；死路只在前者中出现。
hypotheses.en: Histories are of two kinds: unending sequences (the core's runs) and finite courses (Trace); dead ends occur only in the first.

hypotheses.zh: 一族历史是序列对上的谓词；族之间的相等以“对每段历史等价”陈述，不用函数外延性。
hypotheses.en: A family is a predicate on pairs of sequences; families are compared by equivalence at every history, without function extensionality.

does_not_show.en: Whether an actual unfolding's histories stop is not settled here; the core's runs are unending, which is where dead ends come from.
does_not_show.zh: 实际展开的历史是否终止，这里没有判定；核心的运行不终止，死路正由此而来。

does_not_show.en: Which family of histories an actual unfolding is lies outside these laws.
does_not_show.zh: 实际展开是哪一族历史，在这些规律之外。

detail.zh: 死路：有一步而没有历史的律（DeadEnd.no_history），它的步不是活的（DeadEnd.not_live）；拼接：重访的历史所显示的律容许它没走过的历史（Splice.spliced）。
detail.en: Dead end: a law with a step and no history (DeadEnd.no_history), whose step is not live (DeadEnd.not_live); splice: the law a revisiting history shows admits a history it never took (Splice.spliced).

The author's counterreview is in the integration note; there is no independent review yet.
validation_scope.zh: 由 Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器（check_becoming.py）实查：核心模块 Becoming.Histories、Labelled、Unfolding、Frame、Laws、Joint 与基础模块 GenerativeCore 的当前字节绑定到 becoming-checks/ 中通过的回执，所引声明的公理报告皆为空，并核对核心只用 Lean 前导即可编译。作者反审见整合文档；尚无独立审查。

next_delta.en: The same correspondence for weighted laws and their sums over histories (see sum-over-histories-exact); continuous time.

correspondence.en: Following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: completeness in the strong sense, the laws of a kind being all its laws, held before for counting only (tally_iff_counted). The case of one history showed that a history fixes the law it shows and named where the correspondence is not an identity, dead ends and splices; this shows that these two are the whole of it. An AI reading: law and history are one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding (its source, Ren's “there are no two realities” of 12 October 2026, is in the references); with this result, a law read off histories is a family of histories holding its splices and nothing else; what a law set over the unfolding can add are dead ends, which no history shows; the splice is memory's absence: a law answers from where one is, not from how one came there.
correspondence.zh: 按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：完备在强的意义上，即一类规律是该类的全部规律，此前只对计数成立（tally_iff_counted）。一段历史的情形证明历史固定它所显示的律，并指出对应不是同一之处：死路与拼接；这里证明这两者就是全部。AI 的读法：律与历史是同一展开的两种读法，律从展开读出（其来源 Ren 2026-10-12 的“there are no two realities”见参考）；在本结果之下，从历史读出的律就是含有拼接的历史族，别无其他；置于展开之上的律所能多出的只是死路，没有历史显示它们；拼接是记忆的缺席：律从所在处作答，不从怎样来到此处作答。

detail.zh: 复用 P69 的 Run、DeadEnd 与对应的界限：一段历史的情形（Shown、Consistent、exists_law_iff）推广到历史族，死路与拼接成为全部规律。
detail.en: Reuses P69's runs, DeadEnd and the limits of the correspondence: the case of one history (Shown, Consistent, exists_law_iff) generalizes to families, dead ends and splices becoming the whole law.

output.zh: 一段历史所显示的律、死路与拼接的见证。
output.en: The law one history shows, and the witnesses of dead end and splice.

input.zh: 律与历史族的完备对应。
input.en: The complete correspondence of laws and families of histories.

detail.zh: 复用 Determined：确定的律的历史族恰是含有拼接且一致的族。
detail.en: Reuses Determined: the families of determined laws are exactly those holding their splices and consistent.

detail.zh: 外围的迹与律的等价；这里在核心中给出律与历史族的完备对应。
detail.en: The periphery's equivalence of traces and laws; here the complete correspondence of laws and families of histories in the core.

detail.zh: 保留的历史从不返回；它所显示的律只容许它（P69 的 Run.keepHistory_shown）。
detail.en: A kept history never returns; the law it shows admits only it (P69's Run.keepHistory_shown).
